heading: Privacy *notice*
intro: This notice explains what personal information Catholic Rosaries UK collects through this website, why, and what your rights are under UK data protection law (UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018).

sections.heading: Who I am
content: Catholic Rosaries UK is run by Anna Nikiel, a sole trader based in Manchester, United Kingdom. I am the “controller” of your personal information. You can contact me about anything in this notice using the [contact form](./#contact) or by emailing [hello@catholicrosaries.uk](mailto:hello@catholicrosaries.uk).

sections.heading: What I collect and why
content: **Newsletter:** your email address, the date you signed up and the date you confirmed. I use it only to send you the newsletter. The lawful basis is your **consent**, which you give by confirming your subscription.
**Contact form:** your name, email address and message. I use them only to reply to you. The lawful basis is my **legitimate interest** in answering the questions people send me.
Orders are placed on Etsy, not on this website. Etsy’s own privacy policy covers your orders.

sections.heading: Who processes it for me
content: **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** runs the forms, stores the mailing list and sends emails, in its London (UK) region.
**GitHub Pages** hosts this website and may log technical information such as your IP address for security.
**Google Fonts** supplies the website’s fonts, so your browser connects to Google when the page loads.
I never sell your information or share it for marketing.

sections.heading: How long I keep it
content: If you sign up but don’t confirm, your email address is deleted automatically after 7 days.
If you unsubscribe, your email address is deleted from the mailing list straight away.
Contact form messages are kept in my email inbox for up to [2 years] in case you get in touch again, then deleted.

sections.heading: Your rights
content: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information I hold about you, object to how I use it, or withdraw your consent at any time. Every newsletter has an unsubscribe link. To exercise any of these rights, please [get in touch](./#contact).
If you’re unhappy with how I’ve handled your information, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at [ico.org.uk](https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/).

sections.heading: Cookies
content: This website doesn’t use cookies or tracking.
